main_text.p: Ambitiosorū ingenium ex presfum. Satagunt, sed nihil agunt. posset quæ promittebat, sed vt spe impletos, in societatis iure retineret. Prima tamē illi expeditio aduersus Dardanos fuit: qui absentiam eius occupantes, maiore belli mole Macedoniæ imminebant. Cum Romanis quoque pacem facit, contentus interim bellum Macedonicum dissimulasse: Philopœmeni Achæorum duci, quem ad Romanos, sociorum animos sollicitare didicerat, insidias pratendit. Quibus ille cognitis, vitatisq; discedere ab eo Achæos auctoritate sua coëgit.
main_text.head: POMPEII TROGI EPITOMA HISTORIARVM
LIBER XXX.
main_text.p: 1 Ptolemæi Ægyptii regis luxuria, vecordia, parricidia.20 cipiunt, Philippumq; prius bello reducunt ad humilioremSmentem.
2 Miserrimus Ægypti status sub turpissimo principe, cuius meretrix & lenones crudeli fato pereunt.
3 Mortuo Ptolemæo Romani tutelam pupilli aduersus Antiochum Syrum & Philippum Macedonē suf- cipiunt, Philippumq; prius bello reducunt ad humiliorem mentem.25
4 Terræmotus ingentes. Romani pacem repudiant. Philippus & Flaminus suos ad pugnam accendunt. Macedonas Romana fortuna vincit, & Philippus spoliatur.

page.notes: Part 1 of 2; the page continues beyond the cut. Line-number marks 10 and 15 are printed in the right margin. Some words in the first lines are faint and uncertain (e.g. "posset", "spe", "dissimulasse", "pratendit"), but were read as printed. The first column's line-end words are partly garbled in the scan; the section 3 line "Philippum Macedonē" and "cipiunt" in column two are read from a narrow repeated crop. Initial letter read as P, joined to "HILIPPO" (PHILIPPO). Numbers 20, 25, 30 are printed in the right margin.
